name: GauntletBenchmark
description: A multi-domain agent benchmark covering five task categories: Workflow Builder (n8n-style pipelines), 3D Modeller (Three.js scenes), Video Editor (browser-based timeline), Circuit Designer (CircuitJS), and Flight Analyser (ADS-B replay). Each category contains 20 tasks at easy, medium, and hard difficulty levels.

distribution.name: workflow_builder_ground_truth_files
distribution.description: Expected final workflow-graph state, one JSON file per task (task1.json–task20.json). Task number N corresponds to tc_graph_NNN. The gt field in the YAML is empty for Workflow Builder tasks; these files are the authoritative ground truth used by the evaluator.

distribution.name: 3d_modeller_ground_truth_files
distribution.description: Expected final 3D scene state, one JSON file per task (task1.json–task20.json). Task number N corresponds to tc_3d_NNN. The gt field in the YAML is empty for 3D Modeller tasks; these files are the authoritative ground truth used by the evaluator.

distribution.name: 3d_modeller_tolerance_overrides
distribution.description: JSON object mapping task numbers (string keys) to absolute numeric tolerances for floating-point scene-property comparison. Tasks absent from this file use the evaluator default tolerance. Currently overrides tasks 7 and 16 (tolerance 0.5).

distribution.name: video_editor_ground_truth_files
distribution.description: Expected editor-operations sequence, one JSON file per task (tc_vid_001.json–tc_vid_020.json). The filename matches the task id directly. The gt field in the YAML is empty for Video Editor tasks; these files are the authoritative ground truth used by the evaluator.

recordSet.name: workflow_builder_tasks
recordSet.description: 20 Workflow Builder tasks (7 easy, 6 medium, 7 hard) targeting n8n-style pipelines.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique task identifier (tc_graph_001–tc_graph_020).

field.name: difficulty_level
field.description: Task difficulty: easy | medium | hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Markdown task instruction shown to the agent, including goal, numbered steps, and expected JSON result format.

field.name: gt_asset_path
field.description: Relative path to the authoritative ground-truth JSON file for this task inside workflow-builder-gt-fileset. Derived from the task index: tc_graph_NNN -> assets/graph_ground_truth/taskN.json (leading zeros stripped). The inline gt field in the YAML is empty for all Workflow Builder tasks.

recordSet.name: 3d_modeller_tasks
recordSet.description: 20 3D Modeller tasks (2 easy, 10 medium, 8 hard) targeting a Three.js-based scene editor.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique task identifier (tc_3d_001–tc_3d_020).

field.name: difficulty_level
field.description: Task difficulty: easy | medium | hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Markdown task instruction shown to the agent, including goal, numbered steps, and expected JSON result format.

field.name: gt_asset_path
field.description: Relative path to the authoritative ground-truth JSON file for this task inside 3d-modeller-gt-fileset. Derived from the task index: tc_3d_NNN -> assets/3d_ground_truth/taskN.json (leading zeros stripped). The inline gt field in the YAML is empty for all 3D Modeller tasks. Numeric tolerance for floating-point comparison is read from the 3d_modeller_tolerance_overrides FileObject.

recordSet.name: video_editor_tasks
recordSet.description: 20 Video Editor tasks (2 easy, 9 medium, 9 hard) targeting a browser-based timeline editor.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique task identifier (tc_vid_001–tc_vid_020).

field.name: difficulty_level
field.description: Task difficulty: easy | medium | hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Markdown task instruction shown to the agent, including goal, numbered steps, and expected JSON result format.

field.name: gt_asset_path
field.description: Relative path to the authoritative ground-truth JSON file for this task inside video-editor-gt-fileset. The filename is the task id + '.json': assets/video_ground_truth/{id}.json. The inline gt field in the YAML is empty for all Video Editor tasks.

recordSet.name: circuit_designer_tasks
recordSet.description: 20 Circuit Designer tasks (2 easy, 9 medium, 9 hard) targeting CircuitJS. Tasks cover digital logic, analogue measurement, and sequential circuits.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique task identifier (tc_circuit_001–tc_circuit_020).

field.name: difficulty_level
field.description: Task difficulty: easy | medium | hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Markdown task instruction shown to the agent, including goal, numbered steps, component values, wiring instructions, and expected JSON result format.

field.name: gt
field.description: Inline ground truth. For digital-logic tasks: the serialised CircuitJS netlist string the evaluator compares against. For analogue-measurement tasks: the exact numeric reading (e.g. voltage, frequency) expected from the simulator.

recordSet.name: flight_analyser_tasks
recordSet.description: 20 Flight Analyser tasks (2 easy, 9 medium, 9 hard) based on a fixed ADS-B replay session. Tasks require counting aircraft, detecting border crossings, tracking movements, and extracting telemetry.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique task identifier (tc_frad_001–tc_frad_020).

field.name: difficulty_level
field.description: Task difficulty: easy | medium | hard.

field.name: prompt
field.description: Markdown task instruction shown to the agent, including goal, numbered steps, and expected JSON result format.

field.name: gt
field.description: Inline ground truth containing the exact answer values the evaluator checks against (callsigns, counts, UTC times, telemetry readings).

field.name: eval_config
field.description: Optional per-task evaluator configuration (e.g. tolerance_fields with numeric tolerances for fields such as num_country_borders). Absent on most tasks.
